invariantPlugin.gate: Do not register until imports/migration and every creation/allocation/deletion caller including WOF/Site Checks have switched to reviewed workflows. It intentionally blocks legacy manual numbering and registered-ledger edits. Registered Void needs its separate atomic operation before rollout. Verify cascading deletes and privilege-bypass permissions in approved environment tests.
